children: DIAGNOS Inc. (V.ADK) Hit a new 52-Week High of 48 cents. In mid-August, Diagnos received Medical Device Marketing Authorization for the CARA System from the Saudi Food and Drug Authority.

Altius Minerals Corp (T.ALS) Hit a new 52-Week High of $67.53. Altius has renewed its Normal Course Issuer Bid by which it may purchase at market price up to 587,482 common shares, being approximately 1% of the 58,748,220 common shares issued and outstanding as of August 11.

Emperor Metals Inc. (C.AUOZ) Hit a new 52-Week High of 50 cents. Emperor reported results from the latest assay release of its 2026 exploration campaign at the Duquesne West Project. The program comprised 20,479 meters of new drilling and approximately 8,000 meters of targeted historical previous unsampled core, generating more than 28,000 meters of combined drilling data to further refine and expand the resource model.

Big Ridge Gold Corp. (V.BRAU) Hit a new 52-Week High of 65 cents. This summer, Big Ridge awarded a total of 4,300,000 options to its officers under the terms of the Company's Amended and Restated Option Plan. These options are exercisable at a price of $0.45 per share, expire on July 1, 2031, and vested immediately upon grant.

Cabral Gold Inc. (V.CBR) Hit a new 52-Week High of 65 cents. Thursday, Cabral announced results from ten additional diamond drill holes at the Jerimum Cima target located within the Cuiú Cuiú Gold District, Brazil.

Centerra Gold Inc. (T.CG) Hit a new 52-Week High of $33.58. Last week, Metal Energy Corp. announced the closing of the additional strategic investments by existing shareholders, Centerra Gold and Teck Resources Limited, pursuant to the exercise of their respective 'top-up rights' to maintain their respective 9.9% equity interests in the Company, as provided under their respective investor rights agreements.

Copper Giant Resources Corp. (V.CGNT) Hit a new 52-Week High of $1.36. Thursday, Copper Giant reported assay results from in-fill holes MD-068 and MD-070 at its flagship Mocoa copper-molybdenum porphyry project in Putumayo, Colombia.

Coast Copper Corp. (V.COCO) Hit a new 52-Week High of 35 cents. Coast Copper announced that all 8,000,000 common share purchase warrants with an exercise price of $0.10 and whose expiry date was accelerated to July 17, have been exercised, bringing in a total of $800,000 into treasury. Approximately 49% of the Warrants were held by Insiders of the Company.

Cavvy Energy Limited (T.CVVY) Hit a new 52-Week High of $2.22. Earlier this month, Cavvy announced its second-quarter 2026 financial and operating results. The Company produced 21,497 boe/d of hydrocarbons, 984 mt/d of sulphur, and generated Net Operating Income of $49.6 million in the second quarter of 2026.
Cybeats Technologies Inc. (C.CYBT) Hit a new 52-Week High of 25 cents. Cybeats will release its financial results for the three and six months ended June 30, after market close on Monday August 31.
Discovery Mining Ltd. (T.DSV) Hit a new 52-Week High of $12.76. Discovery reported revenue of $319.1M, more than double the Q2 2025 level and 12% higher than Q1 2026.

title: Diagnos, Altius, Emperor Metals at 52-Week High on News
